introAnimation.message: Welcome to Casa Perelos, your rural retreat in the heart of Galicia.

entry.helper: Once the heartbeat ends, press to explore Casa Perelos.

hero.title: Discover Casa Perelos
hero.subtitle: An eighteenth-century manor lovingly restored so you can unwind among Galician nature, tradition and flavours.

story.title: A manor house with a soul
story.body: Every room keeps the original stonework and the warmth of Galician wood. We want you to feel you're arriving at a lived-in home, not just a hotel.
points: Bright spaces overlooking the Miño valley.
Common rooms created for long conversations and shared meals.
story.imageAlt: Main living room at Casa Perelos with the lareira lit
story.caption: The lareira fireplace, a natural gathering spot for guests and hosts.

rooms.title: Rooms and corners full of character
rooms.subtitle: Master suite, boutique bedrooms and shared rooms bathed in natural light.

cards.title: Cordas Suite
cards.body: Generous bedroom with glass gallery, noble fabrics and a private rain shower bathroom.

cards.title: A Corte Room
cards.body: Cosy room with stone walls, wooden scents and views over the historic courtyard.

cards.title: Living room with lareira
cards.body: Shared lounge to enjoy homemade breakfasts and evenings by the fire.
cards.imageAlt: Casa Perelos lounge with sofas and fireplace

highlights.title: What makes your stay special
highlights.subtitle: Family-run service, local produce and tailored experiences.

items.title: Homemade breakfasts
items.body: Freshly baked bread, artisanal jams and coffee roasted in Galicia.

items.title: Curated routes
items.body: We guide you through wineries, viewpoints and charming villages across the Ribeira Sacra.

items.title: Sustainable details
items.body: Renewable energy, eco-friendly amenities and local suppliers.

experiences.title: Live the Ribeira Sacra from within
experiences.subtitle: Terraced vineyards, waterfalls and Romanesque heritage surround us.

items.title: Trails by the Miño
items.body: Walk among century-old chestnut trees and discover sweeping valley views.

items.title: Waterfalls and natural pools
items.body: The Augacaída waterfall is a short hike straight from our doorstep.

items.title: Heroic wine tourism
items.body: Taste wines crafted on steep terraces alongside local winemakers.

experiences.imageAlt: Waterfall in the natural surroundings of Casa Perelos
experiences.imageCaption: Augacaída waterfall, an essential excursion during your stay.

gallery.title: Snapshots of Casa Perelos
gallery.subtitle: Stone courtyard, sunlit terraces and thoughtful details.

images.caption: The inner courtyard, ideal for an evening coffee.
Terrace overlooking the meadows around the house.
Traditional kitchen ready for tastings and show-cooking.
Native forests and waterfalls just minutes away.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.body: Write to us and we'll help you craft a tailor-made stay at Casa Perelos.
